counting_rules: Counting starts after the Knowledge workspace is open.
Each state-changing activation, submitted text entry, facet change, tab or panel transition, result or detail selection, approval, back, retry, or refresh counts as one action.
Focus movement and automatic rendering count as zero actions.
Default selection counts as zero only when the selected content is already visible.
Recovery routes are listed separately and are not hidden in the happy-path total.
A workspace switch is never an accepted action in this v1 walkthrough.

citations.claim: The existing workspace tab primitive owns tab transitions, selected state, panels, and keyboard arrows; the registry now exposes four tabs, with LLMWiki browse as the accepted fourth-tab surface.
The Knowledge Hub opens one workspace shell, mounts the accepted LLMWiki lifecycle and browse panels alongside Zettelkasten and PARA, and does not introduce a second workspace route.
Candidate review exposes title/detail, taxonomy confirmation, provenance, and approval/defer/reject actions in the detail surface.
Explorer selection transitions move from domain to middle section to detail and support back without a workspace switch.
The detail pane has an explicit scroll owner, back action, status copy, hydration sections, and candidate inbox region.
Hub loading failures render a bounded retry/error state inside the existing mount.
